what_it_does: This work reveals a gap in how we evaluate multimodal language models (AI systems that understand both text and images) for scientific reasoning. Current tests measure only end-to-end performance without showing where or why models fail. The researchers decompose scientific question-answering into smaller subtasks (mapping coordinates, computing pixel positions) and test Gemini 2.5 Pro and Qwen2.5-VL-32B on high-resolution visual data, exposing that these models struggle without scripting or tool use.
